description: Splits a secret into shares and rebuilds it from any chosen number of them, using Shamir's secret sharing. Everything runs inside the tool window: nothing is stored, downloaded or sent. The default Sanctum share format records how many shares are needed and adds a check to each share, so a wrong, mistyped or mixed share gives a clear error instead of a wrong secret. A plain format is also available. The tool asks Sanctum for no access at all.

changes.text: Split a secret into shares and rebuild it from any chosen number of them.
The Sanctum share format, which records the threshold and a set id and checks every share.
A plain share format that uses the same bytes as ssss-made-easy and the shamir-secret-sharing npm package.
Secrets are masked and hidden again after 60 seconds without typing or when you switch tabs.
First release signed by Enigma Technologies Solutions.
